summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True only when the control was written. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only renderer test). Not run: tests and Black, per instructions; formatting was checked by hand against 88 columns. set_window_title has no try/except, per the constraint not to catch wrapper exceptions.
